items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Well, later on when he started playing the horn, then I used him too, you know.

ctx.x: Yes. They'd come up there and sing, haven't you, night sound, why, you know, when I'd have them. And that's where I first met Louis. You went to work? Well, later on when he started playing the horn, then I used him too, you know. But he didn't take up this horn until after he went to this home. He did. And they'd give him these instruments, you know, in order to, you know.
And when we come to St. Louis here, here, I mean to St. Louis. I know, yes. Louis come up on a boat with the red, what's his name, red, that used to work on the boat? Oh yeah.
